# Transport: full tables

Appendix to [README.md](README.md), section 4.1. Clean run of 2026-11-13, 3 runs per row.

- **size**: message payload in bytes; **rate**: messages per second sent; 5 s per run (at least 100 messages).
- **case**: `ros` ROS 2 (rclcpp, Fast DDS, reliable; with zero copy in the fixed-size table), `gz` gz-transport, `pdu-100` Hakoniwa shared memory with the receiver checking every 100 µs, `pdu-0` the same without pause (the receiver uses one CPU).
- **received**: per run / sent; **corrupt**: messages whose content did not match what was sent.
- **p50 / p99 / max**: latency from the send call to the receive callback (CLOCK_MONOTONIC); p50 is the median of the 3 runs (range in brackets).
- **CPU recv / send**: CPU time of the receiver / sender per wall second.
